scope: Pre-pilot integration repairs; no May-1 scientific pilot result existed at these fixes

defects.symptom: Mixed timestamp dtypes in accounting partition concatenation
defects.root_cause: Empty partitions and differing timestamp units
defects.exact_fix: Skip empty eligible workload partitions and normalize UTC timestamps before arithmetic
defects.scientific_impact: Causal membership and workload arithmetic corrected before sealing

defects.root_cause: Duplicate keyword already present in runtime authority
defects.exact_fix: Use the runtime authority's verified issue_time once

defects.symptom: AIDC temporal domain could retain old runtime-derived starts
defects.exact_fix: Recompute the existing earliest-start domain from common scalar Q90 duration while retaining B0 geometry and RW completion authority

defects.symptom: Migration source rack needed a durable frozen field
defects.exact_fix: Carry initial_Rack_label for RUNNING and use it for the source compute segment

defects.symptom: Coordination dataclasses and infinite solver limits were not JSON serializable
defects.exact_fix: Normalize dataclass/numpy values and explicitly tag nonfinite metadata without changing model values

defects.symptom: Current electrical/common-service identity was not explicit at B1-to-A0 reuse
defects.root_cause: Source/ML checks did not directly compare these two current context values
defects.exact_fix: Require current electrical certificate and common service hash plus pre-solve generation input receipt

defects.symptom: Direct detached child retained a Windows job membership
defects.root_cause: Nested host job semantics despite breakaway creation flag
defects.exact_fix: Create through independent WMI provider with DETACHED_PROCESS and worker-owned streams; verify no job membership and changing heartbeat after launcher exits

defects.symptom: First CIM smoke creation returned invalid parameter 21
defects.exact_fix: Use the supported DETACHED_PROCESS flag 8 and hidden startup
defects.scientific_impact: Infrastructure only; no scientific worker launched

electrical_pre_pilot_revisions: All superseded generation attempts retained under frozen_artifacts/v41_may_campaign/prepilot_archive; current certificate requires a fresh producer, 23234 measured solves, exact readback and independent mapper audit
